evidence_scope.generation_constraint: Generation receives exactly one source_reference image and self-contained prompt text.

observations: Clean two- to three-step cel-shaded form planes
medium_rendering.transferable_rule: Render source-controlled content as polished editorial anime illustration with crisp opaque cel-shaded print planes, not photorealism or 3D.
prompt_clauses: polished editorial anime poster illustration
clean opaque flat-to-gently-graded cel-shaded planes
crisp screen-print-like color separation

observations: Saturated teal, coral, and warm yellow fields
Depth via value grouping rather than photographic gradients
palette_tone.transferable_rule: Use a limited warm-paper, navy, teal, coral, yellow, and muted-gold print relationship with opaque grouping; preserve literal source colors and identity through relative semantic-region treatment.
prompt_clauses: limited graphic relationship of warm off-white paper ground, deep navy anchors, saturated teal, coral, and warm yellow support colors, with restrained matte-gold line-and-dot accents
Treat each visible source semantic region relatively, never by replacing its literal identity

observed_relative_behavior.value: light plane with restrained darker warm band
observed_relative_behavior.chroma: subdued warm relationship against saturated supports

skin.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Preserve the source's literal skin identity; translate only its relative light, shadow, highlight, and contour grouping into graphic cel-shaded planes.
prompt_clauses: render skin as a source-preserved coherent light-to-shadow cel-shaded plane with a restrained warm shadow band, sparse narrow highlight, and selective deep-navy contour
Never assign a fixed skin tone or change source identity

observed_relative_behavior.chroma: limited cool teal/cyan and warm coral accents
observed_relative_behavior.shading: separated value blocks and rim/strand planes

hair.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Preserve source hair color, silhouette, arrangement, and identity while grouping its values as a dark mass with restrained cool/warm accent relationships.
prompt_clauses: group hair in its source-preserved silhouette and literal color identity as a dark value mass with restrained cool teal/cyan and warm coral accent planes or rim strands, controlled value blocks, and tapered navy contour
Do not alter hairstyle, hair color, or hair identity

observed_relative_behavior.value: interlocking dark, pale, and accented planes

clothing.source_preserving_transferable_rule: Preserve source garments and markings while simplifying their existing values and folds into limited-palette print facets, anchored by dark seams and subtle texture.
prompt_clauses: simplify clothing into source-preserved garment shapes and markings using a few interlocking value planes, dark seam and edge anchors, selective teal/coral/warm-yellow harmonizing facets, and subtle print texture
Do not replace the source outfit, markings, or logos

observations: Adaptable circles, panels, rules, diagonals, curved sweeps, dots, and connectors
line_shape.transferable_rule: Use decisive variable-weight navy ink plus sparse tapered detail and adaptable abstract support forms without copying literal teacher geometry.
prompt_clauses: precise variable-weight deep-navy ink contours that resolve into sparse tapered fine strokes
adaptable abstract support forms and sparse fine gold orbital lines, dots, and connectors

texture_material.transferable_rule: Layer light tactile print texture that preserves legibility and avoids copied mark trajectories or damaged overlays.
prompt_clauses: visible warm paper grain
restrained screen-print speckling, imperfect overprint edges, sparse paint flecks, and occasional dry-brush sweeps without obscuring source detail

observations: Broad opaque support fields precede focal content
Sparse fine ornament completes the hierarchy
graphic_language.transferable_rule: Use adaptable asymmetric poster hierarchy and negative-space rhythm around source-controlled content; lettering is conditional on exact caller text.
prompt_clauses: broad opaque abstract fields frame the source-controlled focal content, then sparse fine gold orbital lines, dots, and connectors supply a final ornament layer
Keep broad support fields firm-edged and opaque, with pale negative space and no copied geometry or placement

typography_dialogue.activation: Only when optional text is supplied; when absent, render no text.
typography_dialogue.medium: High-contrast editorial display ink integrated with the poster-print surface.
typography_dialogue.stroke: Elegant, readable calligraphic/display-like primary stroke with crisp edges and restrained fine ink detail.
typography_dialogue.hierarchy: Supplied exact text is the only lettering content and functions as one restrained display accent.
typography_dialogue.orientation: Adapt orientation for readability; do not use a fixed teacher angle.
typography_dialogue.placement_grammar: Use available negative space or a suitable support field without covering important source content or copying teacher placement.
typography_dialogue.ornament: Sparse fine dot/line ornament may frame supplied text without introducing words.
prompt_clauses: If optional text is supplied, render exactly that verbatim text and no other readable or pseudo-readable text

Use it as an opt-in high-contrast editorial display accent with elegant readable calligraphic/display-like ink on a suitably dark or saturated support field, adaptive orientation and placement, and sparse fine dot/line ornament
Do not copy teacher wording, script, language, logo, or text placement
